analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one table row at head line 572 documenting a `darkbloom benchmark --prompt-prep` mode. The row describes a CPU-only benchmark that loads just the tokenizer, times prompt preparation for chat/agent/tool-loop conversations with the prompt token cache's background comparisons off, prints JSON and exits 2 on any token-ID or decoded-field difference. No code, configuration, authorization, attestation, key custody, or protocol behavior changes in this diff. I read the surrounding documented behavior (logout revocation, drain/stop, App Attest enrollment guidance, prefix-cache KV text) and found no new security claims or contradictions with the canonical threat model. The logout text matches A-008 and T-053 (token sent as bearer to the recorded issuer, 204-only confirmation, local deletion otherwise). The new row adds no network surface. It names a source file, PromptPreparationBenchmark.swift, that is not part of the supplied evidence. Remaining unverified contract: whether that benchmark implementation logs prompt content or writes prompts to disk. Synthetic benchmark conversations would not expose consumer data (A-001), and the doc says it prints JSON. This is only a documentation claim, so no finding is warranted, and no threat model update is required.
